_about: Per-item and per-card notes for scripts/grammar-lab-build.js where the source text alone does not say enough, keyed by topic id. An item number holds { text } (the line to read instead) or, for a run-on, { accept: [joining words] } (more valid fixes); card.sections[i].highlight lists which sentences of a writing card's worked passage are highlighted (0 is the first).
